5m2k_exclusion.title: Crystal structure of vancomycin-Zn(II) complex
5m2k_exclusion.benchmark_exclusion_reason: Not a globular protein: 7-residue glycopeptide antibiotic (vancomycin–Zn²⁺) with 6/7 non-standard monomers; only ASN is a standard amino acid. Ramachandran calibration targets standard-protein backbones. wwPDB reports 100% Ramachandran outliers because the backbone geometry is cyclic/modified glycopeptide, not because ChiralFold disagrees on a meaningful protein benchmark point (ChiralFold = 0%).
5m2k_exclusion.citation: Zarkan et al., Sci Rep 7:4893 (2017); PMID 28687742
